principles: Two speeds. The primary tree is shallow and slow: 9 subject main classes chosen by kind of subject (Ranganathan main classes, Propaedia parts) plus 4 apparatus dirs; path depth is at most 3 below the cut. Everything that varies fast lives in facets, registries, edges and computed panels.

Anti-Wilkins. No directory encodes a facet: level, form, era, season, review and valence exist only as closed-vocabulary particles, so undergrad/masters, history/applications and curriculum/case splits disappear from paths. Each subject has one home; every other affinity is a renvoi (typed edge) or a shared concept tag.

Facet citation order follows PMEST: Personality = #:domain, Matter = ^concepts.primary, Energy = #:form, Space = declared gap, Time = #:era then #:season. Every index lists its leaves in this order, so browsing by facet is predictable.

Closed vocabularies with a recurrence rule. Every facet value is declared once in vocabulary.spw with gloss, broader and narrower. A value must appear on at least 2 files and on no more than N/3 files. #:domain is a two-tier lattice (main class -> basic subject), and each basic subject doubles as the anchor prefix. Proposed form set (15): index, glossary_lattice, timeline_ladder, prerequisite_dag, comparison_matrix, state_machine, cadence_schedule, calendar, claim_ledger, case_dossier, probe_battery, protocol, registry, trail, panel. Level: intro, foundation, advanced, graduate, practitioner. Layer: reference, pragmatics, semantics, creative. Review: unreviewed, spot_checked, source_checked, code_verified, expert_reviewed. Era: ancient, medieval, early_modern, industrial, electric, postwar, networked, platform. Season: reflection, gathering, crescendo, celebration, reset.

Three tiers in every class (Britannica): the class index is the Propaedia section, <class>-glossary.spw is the Micropaedia (short lattice entries), and the leaves are the Macropaedia (treatments with deep frames).

Every claim is a Wikidata-style statement. The keystone value is anchored #>domain_topic_claim; qualifiers are holds/fails/scope/as_of; references are src_ anchors in registries/sources; rank is #:claim status. Refuted and superseded claims keep deprecated rank in the provenance errata instead of being deleted.

Visible gaps. Every class index carries an authored ^["gaps"] frame of predicted empty cells. panels/gap-table.spw also computes the empty domain x form and domain x level cells. A gap is information, as in Mendeleev's table.

Authored and computed stay apart. Edges and affinity panels are authored claims. computed-kin and facet-census are generated prompts: fingerprinted, regenerated, never hand-edited. This follows the plan-index doctrine the repo already runs.

Registries are the single source for numbers and bibliography. $%[] cites only registered ns.key_unit handles. An unsourced cell stays empty with status unverified. Numbers inside prose are allowed only when the registry cell is cited next to them.

Fixity and lineage. The raw tree is archived as a tarball with a sha256 in provenance/manifest.spw, and every raw path gets one disposition row. Each new file's ^"provenance" lineage names its raw paths as quoted strings, never ~ refs, so deleting the raw tree breaks nothing.

Harm and currency. Physiology, nursing and community-care surfaces are knowledge maps and histories, never advice. Harmful raw claims are recorded pointer-only in harm-register. Dated platform, market, festival and guideline facts carry as_of and #:season, and they are receipts, not evergreen truth.

Addressability. Anchors are unique across the cut and prefixed by domain; src_ and qty_ are the only reserved non-domain prefixes, and they are used in registries. Leaf basenames are unique except index.spw and the paired registry files, so the atlas basename fallback cannot confuse two leaves. No path contains an LSP tier substring. Children never link to parents; trails and bundles provide the paths.

Edge semantics are read from the declaring file: 'A needs B' means B is a prerequisite; 'A feeds B' means A is input to B; 'A grounds B' means A is evidence for B; extends, contrasts, analog, supersedes and case_of read the same way.

Bundling resonance. Each index's ^["bundle"] transcludes its leaves' keystone claim anchors, so `spw expand` on any class index yields a digest. Trails are Memex paths that publish as ordered sequences, and each leaf's ^"emit" card makes it a standalone pack.

Wonder is combinatorial, not ad hoc. Lenses come from the canon's closed set of six, depth from canon's five, and probe kinds from a closed list (measure, compare, trace, replicate, falsify, interview, archive, build, observe). panels/llull-wheel.spw crosses lens x domain x probe kind x era to generate questions, so wonder blocks cluster instead of minting one-off lenses.

writer_packages.notes: Write first, and freeze vocabulary.spw and contract.spw before other writers start. owns_dirs entries are non-recursive: '2026-09-30/' means only the root files index/vocabulary/contract. Transcribe the scorecard into review-scorecard and the three errata ledgers (raw path:line, gist, correction, corrected-in anchor). The harm register is pointer-only: never restate a dose, diet or protocol. Compute the tarball sha256 into the manifest. Registries/index defines handle grammar and cell status values. Also reads the scorecard md and scratchpad understand-out/*.md.

Theory files are questions for the owner, never canon edits; cite canon and code as root-relative bias edges. Every Spw claim needs code or canon evidence, otherwise it is interpretive or speculative. spw-position-matrix must cover every sigil and treat valence as material (valence-architecture.spw). Practice files are speculative by contract. Also reads scratchpad understand-out tags/linking/theory_state/ocean_cluster/metrics.

Every row is code_verified against extensions/ and packages/spw-lsp with file:line. Carry the 7 verified plugin defects plus the LSP anchor-line and lens-index gaps. History cases come from git log, .agents/plans and the scorecard; commit counts are as_of 2026-09-30. Never embed absolute user paths.

Theorem ledgers must restore dropped hypotheses as qualifiers. Rebuild the curriculum DAG so every prerequisite resolves to a week anchor. Refresh dated engine and scheduler names (Turboshaft, EEVDF, Rocq) with as_of. engineering-math-bridge draws probability, statistics and numerics as visible empty nodes.

Apply every scorecard fix (Landauer magnitude, 1/T relation, universality class, 2.66 squeeze ratio, Petzval sum). Thermodynamics survives only as a concept tag and edges. Optics is shared with the light-to-image trail, so keystone claims need stable anchors. owns physical/index.spw and physical-glossary.spw (non-recursive).

Material histories keep myths as #!refuted or #!contested claims with sources (Damascus folding, Hittite monopoly, Wittfogel). Mechanical core becomes the single thermo-fluids home. ISE absorbs the misnamed design-systems file.

New timeline research: every date gets a src_ anchor or #!contested (paper origins, codex adoption, Samarkand legend). reference-works-lineage and archive-patterns-matrix are the design basis for the cut, so coordinate with cut-apparatus but do not edit vocabulary.spw. owns record/index.spw and record-glossary.spw (non-recursive).

Mostly new research: sound and moving-image ladders, format wars (rank popular explanations by evidence; the adult-content explanation for VHS is contested), carrier manufacturing and decay. Process temperatures and times go in registry cells. Visual-arts leaves carry the scorecard fixes (twelve principles, McCloud credit, G3).

Apply the fixes (Cas9 search, Na+ inactivation, PECAM). Resolve SNARE duplication by edge, and neuroscience/cognition overlap by contrasts edges instead of repeated text. owns living/index.spw and living-glossary.spw (non-recursive); the living index states the no-advice rule for the whole class.

Highest harm load. Development and nursing are knowledge maps: no doses, diets, supplements or protocols, and a honk guard in each leaf. Nursing guideline claims name body, year and status (e.g. vancomycin AUC-guided dosing, 2022 SHEA oral care, SSC sepsis fluids). limiting-nutrients tells public-health history as cases, never advice. The quarantined physiology raws are not inputs; only pointer rows in the harm register. Horticulture's autumn calendar gives the season hook (short-day forcing for December bloom).

Replication status is the key facet in cognition (money priming, ego depletion, marshmallow, nudges). Historical linguistics carries the laryngeal case as a gap-predicts-discovery exemplar. Community roles drop the reverent single voice and the stereotypes; semiotic-charge readings are interpretive and cite dated attestations (dictionary or corpus probes). No health or remediation advice from the community raws.

Markets are hooks: methods protocol, probe battery naming source and release month, and dated receipts. Rebuild the podcast platform shares from the source report with as_of; never reuse the raw numbers. Fiscal calendars mark US federal FY start Oct 1 with #:season reflection. Log the pain-of-paying ethics conflict in food-and-beverage. owns society/index.spw and society-glossary.spw (non-recursive).

TikTok LIVE surfaces are dated receipts: as_of, region qualifiers, every value unverified until sourced; fix payout double-counting; drop the fabricated ranking formula. Author season calendar notes that the NaNoWriMo organization closed in 2025 while the November tradition continues.

Fix turnaround (10h IATSE vs 12h SAG-AFTRA), managers vs agents (Marathon v. Blasi), and the public-domain year. The film season calendar lists 2026-27 dates as unverified until checked against each festival or academy announcement. owns making/index.spw and making-glossary.spw (non-recursive).

The generations kit feeds the owner's site story but is not the story. Keep it descriptive: laws and programs with dates and sources; debates as claims with evidence status; the interview protocol has consent and preservation steps. Secondary and institution files carry the scorecard fixes (IEP participation, dual-credit transfer, senate authority, NSF budget as a dated cell).

Runs last, after every other package publishes its claim-anchor list. Affinity panels are authored interpretive claims, each with a ^[breaks] frame. computed-kin and facet-census are generator outputs (a script modeled on scripts/plans/plan-index.ts); until the generator exists, write stubs that declare the basis and fingerprint fields. The gap table lists authored gaps from class indexes beside computed empty cells.

risks: Size: 274 files and about 42k lines against 208 raw files and 14k lines. Write in two waves: keystones first (vocabulary, contract, class indexes, all raw keeps and fixes), new research second (media history, generations kit, season calendars, theory). Trails and panels run only after every anchor exists.

Vocabulary drift. Sixteen writers will invent facet values, lenses and concept tags unless vocabulary.spw is frozen before writing starts and a plan-index-style validator rejects unknown values. spw lint checks only form, not values.

#:domain can collapse into a copy of the path. The two-tier lattice and the required ^concepts.transfers are the defense; if the census shows domain equals branch everywhere, the facet is carrying no information.

Tooling traps: spw graph reports file#anchor refs as broken and the LSP jumps to line 1. expand resolves cwd-first, so run it from the repo root and avoid bare ./index.spw in bias edges. ~<tag>"path" does not parse. Anchors inside #[] or .{} do not bind, and the validator hides lexer errors. Writers must use only the verified forms and gate on parse().errors.

Harm leakage. Reframed physiology, nursing and community-care surfaces could re-import dosing, diet or remediation advice. Every such leaf needs a honk guard, pointer-only harm references and a reviewer pass. #:review must never claim expert_reviewed for agent work.

Currency. TikTok LIVE gates and gift values, royalty rates, festival and awards dates for the 2026-27 season, NSF budgets and clinical guidelines all change. Stamp as_of on each; leave any value that cannot be sourced empty; flag the season calendars unverified until checked against the 2026 editions.
Fabricated precision. The raw tree held about 49 invented effect sizes. New timelines and calendars invite invented dates. A date with no src_ reference must be marked unverified or left out.

The generations kit touches family and school anxieties. Keep it descriptive (what changed, what the evidence says, what to ask), never evaluative about any generation's schooling; the story itself stays on the owner's site.

Cross-package anchors. Trails, panels, cross_links and bundles need anchors other packages own. File anchors are fixed by this plan; claim anchors are writer-chosen, so each writer should publish a claim-anchor list before the atlas-trails package starts.

Ownership seams: society/, making/, record/ and living/ are split across packages (class index and glossary in one package, branches in others). owns_dirs entries are non-recursive. A class index author must not edit branch files, and branch writers hand their bundle keystones to the class index author.

The Space facet is deliberately missing, so region-dependent facts (platform gates, fiscal years, curricula) rely on qualifiers. That is acceptable for one cut but should be revisited before a second one.
